requirement_ref.quote: An actionable "Add to Cart" button. ... A dedicated shopping cart icon to display or navigate to user selections.

preconditions: STAGE is reachable and the home page loads with the full product catalog

"Wireless Headphones" is currently the first product card in catalog order — this mission targets the first Add to Cart button by position, not by product identity, because there is no per-card locator (e.g. a data-testid) to target the product directly. If the catalog is reordered, this mission will act on whatever product is first, and A1 will correctly fail rather than silently pass, since it checks for the specific title.

No confirmation UI (badge/toast) is assumed after clicking Add to Cart — this was an open gap (G-3) resolved by verifying success on the Cart page instead, per human decision at Gate 1 analysis review
test_objective: Verify that adding a product to the cart makes it appear on the Cart page.

data_policy.cleanup_instruction: No naming_pattern is set — this mission adds an existing catalog item to a cart session rather than creating a new named record (contrast with WorkPod's SM-001, which creates a named entity). The cart is assumed to be session-scoped and ephemeral for an anonymous Guest; this is an assumption, not a confirmed fact (see gap G-3/G-4 in the analysis).

actions.instruction: Add the first product in the grid (expected: Wireless Headphones) to the cart.

target.description: First 'Add to Cart' button in the product grid, targeted by position since no per-card identifier exists
target.name: Add to Cart

actions.instruction: Open the Cart via the top navigation.

target.description: Cart link, scoped to the top nav (the footer's Quick Links repeats the same link text)
target.name: Cart

actions.instruction: Wait for the Cart page to settle.

assertions.statement: "Wireless Headphones" is visible on the Cart page.

target.description: Wireless Headphones line item on the Cart page

assertions.statement: The Cart page URL is reached.
